summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its 3Q2026 earnings release conference, scheduled for October 27, 2026 at 14:00 Seoul time via live internet stream, with Korean and English simultaneous translation and a Q&A session. The filing also designates October 13 through October 27, 2026 as a blackout period. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-notice current report, not a special situation; watch only for quarterly results and any guidance update.
